entityDescription: Feron Technologies P.C. (FERON, GR) is an Athens-based private technology SME (4 employees) with 9 years of experience in developing advanced ICT and IoT testbeds and products. FERON's expertise spans connectivity technologies and protocols, end-to-end communication infrastructures, satellite communications, and full-stack software development (embedded, real-time, front/back-end). It also specializes in SDRs, network measurements, and both lab- and field-based experimentation. Since 2016, FERON has participated in numerous EU Open Call projects (e.g., Fed4Fire, ORCA, 5G-IANA, TARGET-X, and many more), completing 11 successfully. Key projects include Movement for MONROE (4G benchmarking tools), CV2XinFIRE (LTE CV2X modem), NFV2X (V2X virtualization for 5G), 5G-BenchMotiv (5G benchmarking), and Road Hazard for 5G-IANA (intelligent road hazard detection). In recent years, FERON has focused on beyond 5G and 6G technologies for verticals such as industrial automation, connected vehicles, and precision agriculture. Offerings include benchmarking tools, 3GPP/IEEE network simulations, SDN-based reconfiguration solutions, and real-time SDR-based modem implementations. Recently, FERON introduced an enhanced 5G benchmarking solution, building on its earlier 4G/Wi-Fi work.

entityDescription: ASTRO is a startup focused on delivering high-quality Earth observation data through innovative space solutions. Its technology is based on tethered satellite systems, which keep satellites in fixed formation to ensure greater stability and precision in data collection. This approach enhances the resolution and effectiveness of remote sensing for applications such as 3D structure reconstruction, moving object detection, and subsurface stratigraphy. The first mission, ODRADEK, uses two 12U CubeSats connected by a deployable tether of up to 200 meters. This link ensures zero-latency communication and improved stability, enabling superior imaging performance compared to traditional solutions. Modular by design, ODRADEK can host different payloads (optical and/or radar) tailored to customer needs, and is built with commercial off-the-shelf components to reduce costs. ASTRO manages the design and development of critical technologies such as guidance, navigation, and control algorithms, as well as the tether and its deployment system, while collaborating with industrial partners for system integration. Its patented solution positions ASTRO to deliver unique imaging capabilities that combine higher accuracy with lower costs. The company’s primary business model focuses on the sale of satellite imagery. By operating its own systems, ASTRO provides customers with advanced products for environmental monitoring, urban planning, infrastructure management, and defense applications. To diversify before full-scale operations, ASTRO also explores near-space demonstrators (e.g., stratospheric balloons, tethered drones) that validate technologies and generate early revenues.

entityDescription: Belje plus d.o.o. is a leading agricultural enterprise engaged in the integrated production of high-quality agricultural raw materials across eastern Croatia. The company manages over 20.000 hectares of arable land throughout Baranja and the continental part of Croatia, making it one of the region’s largest arable crop producers. Its primary crops wheat, barley, maize, and sugar beet are cultivated from carefully selected seed varieties, supported by modern agronomic practices and continuous investment in staff, irrigation infrastructure, advanced machinery, and agricultural innovation. These strategic investments enable consistently high yields across all key crops. Production is underpinned by cutting-edge technologies like precision tractors equipped with satellite navigation, state-of-the-art implements optimized for large-scale arable operations, and digital monitoring systems for real-time tracking of crop conditions, soil status, and drainage networks. This integrated technological approach ensures operational efficiency under all weather conditions, reduces production costs, and enhances both financial performance and environmental sustainability. In addition to its extensive arable operations, Belje plus d.o.o. maintains integrated livestock production, including meat and dairy processing through its own facilities, thereby securing a comprehensive presence across the agri-food value chain. As a reliable partner in the agricultural and food sectors, Belje plus d.o.o. actively contributes to the sustainable development of rural areas, strengthens Croatia’s agricultural self-sufficiency, and champions the integration of traditional land stewardship with forward-looking, digitally enabled, and environmentally responsible farming practices.

entityDescription:
atmoky is an Austrian SME specializing in high-fidelity spatial audio and acoustic simulation technologies for immersive and interactive environments. Building on expertise in psychoacoustics, signal processing, and real-time 3D rendering, atmoky develops toolkits that enable realistic sound propagation, binaural rendering, and dynamic room acoustics in virtual and mixed-reality scenarios.
Its core platforms, trueSpatial and the upcoming trueAcoustics, are optimized for VR/XR training, simulation, and mission rehearsal applications. These systems allow 3D sound fields to respond to user movement (6DOF), environment geometry, and contextual events, enabling highly immersive and cognitively natural training experiences, particularly valuable in scenarios where visual load is high and auditory cues enhance orientation, situational awareness, and stress management.
atmoky’s solutions integrate seamlessly with established development environments such as Unity, Unreal Engine, FMOD, and Wwise, supporting deployment across head-mounted displays, PC simulators, and multi-speaker training facilities. The company has contributed spatial audio expertise to multiple international research collaborations, focusing on immersive learning, human–machine teaming, and adaptive acoustic environments for cognitive performance, music education and well-being.
Through scientifically grounded design and cross-disciplinary collaboration, atmoky advances spatial audio as a key enabler for next-generation XR training and simulation, including applications relevant to space operations and remote cooperation.

💻 Elemwave Description
 
Elemwave is a company specialized in the development of Computational Electromagnetics (CEM) software, with a particular focus on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) applications.
The company works with major players in the industry, including aerospace giants like Airbus, as a client.
 
What does their software offer?
 
Their main tool, the Elemwave workbench, allows for modeling and simulating typical EMC problems, which often involve the complex interaction between various components:
- Lumped circuits: Discrete circuit elements.

- Cable bundles: Collections of electrical conductors.

- Geometry: Physical 3D structures.

The software is especially useful for:
- Cable bundle modeling: It allows for defining and solving cross-sections of cable bundles with arbitrary shapes. This is crucial for determining the coupling between different conductors and predicting potential electromagnetic interference issues.

In essence, Elemwave provides a solution for engineers who need to analyze, simulate, and mitigate electromagnetic interference problems in the design of products and systems, ensuring they comply with EMC standards.

description:
Alén Space is a Spanish company dedicated to the design, manufacturing and operation of small satellites. Its main objective is to help space agencies, companies, institutions and high-tech centers advance their objectives with its state-of-the-art space/ground segment products and with the development of end-to-end nanosatellite missions.
 

Thanks to a highly qualified team of more than 70 engineers and technicians, Alén Space has been able to implement cutting-edge software and hardware for its own small satellites with a 100% success rate. In addition, its products and processes are endorsed by ESA standards (ECSS) and several recognised industry certifications, such as ISO 9001. 

Alén Space will bring its recognized experience of more than 15 years in the development of Cubesats and Payloads. The services of Alén Space cover all essential aspects of any type of space project: platform and mission design; payload development and manufacturing; assembly, integration and verification (AIV) phase and support of specific satellite operations through its Mission Control Software. 

Alén Space ensures that it meets the demands of the industry through its own technologically integrated facilities: central offices, development and assembly laboratory, cleanroom area and a satellite control room. 

Alén Space’s portfolio includes advanced space products and communication subsystems divided into small satellite platforms (1U-16U), closed payloads for space missions, on-board computers (OBC), Software Defined Radios (SDRs) designed for communication applications and ground segment solutions (ground stations and communication systems) prepared to operate in different radio frequency bands (UHF, VHF & S-band). 

Recognition and success have marked the trajectory of Alén Space. Therefore, its achievements have led the company to become part of the technology multinational GMV in 2023, a strategic alliance with the purpose of growing together in a highly competitive and constantly innovative environment. 

Alén's success rate combined with state-of-the-art technology and processes based on European sector standards has earned the trust of the world’s leading space organizations and agencies, such as the European Space Agency (ESA), the German Aerospace Center (DLR), the Brazilian Space Agency (AEB)and the Spanish National Institute of Aerospace Technology (INTA).

Since its beginnings back in 2008 in the aerospace strategic group of the University of Vigo, the Alén Space team has developed, manufactured, launched and operated several SmallSats. In chapter 2.3, Heritage and Starting Point, some of the projects that Alén Space has developed are presented.

Alén Space has 2 main product lines, one for the Space Segment and one for the Ground Segment.

Regarding the Space Segment, Alén Space offers 2 SDR platforms, TOTEM and TREVO, with both of them having flight heritage. These SDRs can be the core of communications payloads and are able to be integrated in various types of space missions. Alén Space also offers the closed RF payloads based on the aforementioned SDRs. Additionally, the company offers Cubesat Platforms ranging from 1U to 16U. These platforms can be offered as standard solutions in which customers can integrate their payloads, or can be offered as highly optimized solutions, including the payload, and as part of turnkey missions. Finally, Alén Space offers 2 On-Board Computer Models, DARA and TRISKEL. The latter also integrates a UHF Telemetry and Telecommand submodule. 

In parallel, in terms of Ground Segment products, Alén Space has designed and developed a ready-to-assemble Ground Station Kit solution, which is offered in various versions. It can work in the UHF, VHF, L- and S- Bands.

 
More information regarding the products offered by Alén Space can be retrieved from the company´s website. Upon request, Alén Space can provide further information regarding its products, such as their datasheets and more.

entityName: University of Ljubljana, Faculty of Electrical Engineering - Lighting and Photometry Laboratory
entityDescription: The Lighting and Photometry Laboratory (LRF) was founded in 1921 as part of the Electrical Engineering Department of the then Faculty of Technology. The laboratory carries out research, teaching and professional work in different fields. We are involved in research on light sources and luminaires and their applications. In addition, we design lighting and carry out calculations of illuminance and brightness in indoor and outdoor spaces. We are also consultants to major Slovenian lighting companies. In our laboratory we also perform photometric measurements: integrating luminous flux measurements, directional and goniophotometric luminance measurements, luminance and brightness measurements with portable instruments and spectroradiometers. These also allow measurements of the spectral content of light, the colour of light and the colour appearance index. The laboratory also performs calibrations of brightness and luminance meters and develops photometric measurement equipment for our own needs and for clients.

entityDescription:
Involve Space – Insight from above, Impact on the ground
Involve Space is an Italian aerospace company that designs, develops, and launches intelligent pseudo-satellite platforms based on space balloons for Earth observation, defense, flight validation, and scientific research. With over 30 successfully launched missions, it is the leading Italian provider and one of the European leaders in the stratospheric mission sector.
The proprietary technology, capable of reaching altitudes of 30 km in suborbit, allows for close-up observation of the Earth with resolutions of up to 0.3 meters/pixel, eliminating the typical revisiting time of satellites, enabling constant and real-time monitoring. The asset can maintain its position and optimize routes based on atmospheric conditions.
Involve Space integrates aerospace hardware, artificial intelligence, and a sustainable approach: its balloons are reusable, zero-emission, and produced in-house. The next frontier is LoonHive®: constellations of decentralized stratospheric balloons for targeted large-scale monitoring, distributed through the tools of the intelligent geospatial platform CLEAR, positioning Involve Space as an end-to-end provider.
Based in Como and with an expanding presence in Europe and the United States, Involve Space aims to be a global reference point in the High Altitude Platforms (HAPS) market, with a clear vision: to bring strategic data from near-Earth space to generate concrete and sustainable impacts.

description: Aurelia is a system-oriented SME that operates in the domains of space technology and high altitude platforms focusing on environmental monitoring, scientific experimentation, and technology demonstration. The company develops and manufactures space systems and subsystems such as microsatellites and solar power assemblies, as well as proprietary miniaturized stratospheric platforms for scientific and technological payloads. In addition, Aurelia develops and operates space-derived sensor suites and lighter-than-air platforms for terrestrial environmental monitoring with applications to smart agriculture, physics of the atmosphere and volcanology. Aurelia benefits of long-standing academic ties and draws on over 30 years of experience in space technology and international project management.
